verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs say mailbox users can ship packages to any address and save by bundling them (forwarding plus consolidation). The mailbox also handles shipments and returns, and plans include forwarding. However, nothing confirms that the address accepts packages from all major carriers or offers in-person pickup or long-term holding. missing for 10: evidence of acceptance from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), hold-for-pickup option, details on consolidation process and storage limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
